transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because of church. I, um... I've been doing some strange things lately. Like at the potluck, I just stood there holding the serving spoon up in the air. I didn't move for a long time. And... sometimes I just fold the same stack of napkins over and over, even when people are waiting for me to help them. I don't really know why.
Do you find yourself doing things like folding those napkins over and over when you're alone, or is it mostly when you're around other people?
I... I don't really know. I haven't paid much mind to it. I suppose I'm mostly by myself at home, so... maybe then too. I'm not sure.
Do you feel nervous or anxious when you're around other people at church or other social gatherings?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get nervous. I just... I just go to the service. That's all.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
Thoughts? No... I don't think so. Just... regular things, I suppose. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Do you feel like you have to fold the napkins or hold the serving spoon in a certain way?
No... not really. I just... I just fold them. It's just something my hands do, I suppose. I don't feel like I have to.
Do you feel like something bad would happen if you didn't fold the napkins or stopped holding the serving spoon?
No... nothing bad. I don't really think about it like that. It's just... just something I do.
Do you ever feel like you're thinking about something over and over that you can't stop?
I don't think so. If I'm done thinking about something, it just... goes away. My mind doesn't really get stuck like that.
Do you have any habits or rituals that you feel are very important to your daily routine?
No... I don't think so. I just go about my day, mostly. There's nothing special I have to do.
Do you feel an urge to perform certain actions, like folding the napkins, in order to make yourself feel better or to relieve some kind of tension?
No... I don't think so. I don't feel tense. I just... I just fold them. It doesn't really mean anything.
Do you feel more calm or relaxed when you're folding the napkins or holding the serving spoon?
No. It doesn't make me feel anything, really. I just do it.
Do you think folding the napkins or doing these repetitive actions helps you avoid feeling anxious or uneasy in any way?
No... I'm not anxious. I don't... it doesn't do anything like that. It's just a napkin. I don't really have a reason.
Do you prefer things to be arranged in a certain way or to be symmetrical?
No... I don't pay much mind to that. Things are just where they are. I don't really care if they line up or anything.
Do you ever have thoughts that you try to ignore or push away, but they keep coming back to your mind?
No... I don't think so. I just have regular thoughts. I don't have anything I need to push away.
Do you feel like your behavior of folding napkins or holding the serving spoon is causing you any problems in your daily life?

Not the napkins, no. But... I guess I have been having some trouble with other things. I've had to step back from the choir... and my volunteering at the church. I just... I get the plans mixed up sometimes. And then people get uncomfortable, or they have to go and redo what I was supposed to handle. So I just stay back now.
Do you think there's a specific reason or thought that makes you want to fold the napkins or hold the serving spoon?
No... I don't think there's a reason. I just... do it. It's just how I do things.
Do you enjoy doing things that you used to find pleasurable, like singing in the choir?
I don't know... I guess I just don't feel like it much lately. It's just... singing. I don't really think about it.
Do you find yourself avoiding social situations or interactions because you feel uncomfortable or because you're worried about how others might react to you?
I guess... I just stay home more. It's easier. I don't really know if I'm worried about them, I just... I'd rather be by myself.
Do you think people at church or elsewhere are uncomfortable around you because of the things you do, like folding napkins or holding the serving spoon?

I suppose... maybe. I've stepped back from volunteering there. And the choir. I just... I get things mixed up sometimes, the plans and all. I think people get a bit uncomfortable. Or they just have to fix what I was supposed to do... so it's better if I just don't.
Do you feel like there's something inside of you that's making you do these repetitive actions?
I don't... no. I don't think it's anything like that. I just... do them. It's just a thing I do.
Do you feel like you're doing these things because a thought is telling you to?
No... I don't think so. It's not like a thought is telling me to do it. I just... I don't really know. I just do it.
